p: God bears with Moses doubting, because he was not completely without faith.
That they may believe that the: This power to work miracles was to confirm his doctrine, and to assure him of his vocation.
water of the river: Because these three signs should be sufficient witnesses to prove that Moses should deliver God's people.
wilt send: That is, the Messiah: or some other, that is more suitable than I.
anger of the LORD was kindled: Though we provoke God justly to anger, yet he will never reject his own.
put words in his mouth: You will instruct him what to say.
God: Meaning, as a wise counsellor and full of God's spirit.
rod of God in his hand: By which he wrought the miracles.
harden his heart: By receiving my spirit and delivering him to Satan to increase his anger.
firstborn: Meaning, most dear to him.
sought to kill him: God punished him with sickness for neglecting his ordinances.
cut off the foreskin of her: This act was extraordinary: for Moses was very sick and God even then required it.
people believed: So that Moses had experience of God's promise that he would have good success.
